text.content:
The Queen of the Fixers.

Role: Fixer
Affiliation: Owner of the Afterlife
Location: The Afterlife, Little China
Known for: Decades as one of the best solos for hire; now assembles elite teams for rich clients

Rogue has been in the business for decades, first as one of the best solos money could hire and now as the city's most respected fixer. She's mostly retired from shooting people herself.

Gig hooks

  • Rogue is putting a team together for a client who insists on staying anonymous.

Edgerunner's Handbook (Edgerunners Mission Kit), p.27
